Wi-Fi from Lounge, keep browsing while VLC plays, and less battery drain.

- **Wi-Fi panel.** Tap the Wi-Fi icon in the top bar (or Wi-Fi in the quick menu) to see your IP address and the networks in range, and switch networks. Saved and open networks connect straight away; new secured ones ask for the password. The icon now also shows, crossed out, when you're disconnected.
- **Lounge stays usable while VLC plays.** Press Back (or "Back to Lounge") on the Playing in VLC screen to keep browsing; the play button in the top bar, or Now playing in the quick menu, brings the controls back.
- **Lower idle power.** Lounge now reads the controller itself, slows down when you're not using it, and stops entirely while a game runs, instead of polling it nonstop in several places.
- **Top bar:** the menu button is always there, and the controller icon is gone.
